title: ESA astronaut Sophie Adenot returns to Earth after record-breaking mission
excerpt: The mission set a new European record for the longest single spaceflight at 237 days, 5 hours and 18 minutes.
bodyHtml:
The European Space Agency announced that astronaut Sophie Adenot returned to Earth on 8 October 2026. Adenot and the Crew-12 team splashed down off the coast of California at 15:34 GMT following an eight-month mission to the International Space Station.

The Dragon Freedom spacecraft carried Adenot along with NASA astronauts Jessica Meir and Jack Hathaway and Roscosmos cosmonaut Andrei Fedyaev. The crew undocked from the station on 7 October and completed a 27 hours and 29 minutes return journey.

The mission lasted a total of 237 days, 5 hours and 18 minutes, exceeding the previous European record for the longest single spaceflight by more than 35 days. Following initial medical checks on the recovery vessel, the crew will travel to Ellington Field in Houston before Adenot continues to the European Astronaut Centre in Cologne, Germany.
